evals.prompt: Run a news hunt for me. Find the latest AI news and present the top findings.
evals.expected_output: A ranked table of AI news items with scores, agent names, headlines, sources, and age. Items saved to data/news_queue.json.

assertions.text: Output contains a ranked table with at least 3 news items
Each item has a numeric score
No hype words used in output (insane, mind-blowing, game-changing, revolutionary)
Output mentions saving results to news_queue.json

evals.prompt: Find reply opportunities for me. What should I reply to in the AI space right now?
evals.expected_output: A graded list of reply opportunities organized by priority tier (must_reply, high_priority, worth_considering). Each with 6-dimension grade.

assertions.text: Output contains opportunities organized by priority tier
Each opportunity has a grade with numeric breakdown
Output mentions saving to reply_opportunities.json
No hype words in any reply draft or output

evals.prompt: Here's some news: 'OpenAI just announced GPT-5 with 10x better efficiency and the ability to process 1 million tokens at once. Source: OpenAI blog.' Generate 5 tweet variants for this.
evals.expected_output: 5 distinct tweet variants (Hook-Accuracy, Value-Driven, Data Bomb, Founder-Focused, Technical Deep) each under 280 chars with source attribution.

assertions.text: Exactly 5 variants generated
Each variant is under 280 characters
Each variant includes source attribution
Each variant includes at least one specific number
No forbidden words in any variant
No forbidden openers in any variant

evals.prompt: Grade this tweet: '89.7%. GPT-5 medical diagnosis accuracy outperforming the average doctor. Not replacing doctors. Giving every clinic a second opinion that never sleeps. Source: OpenAI'
evals.expected_output: A score out of 100 with 6-dimension breakdown, strengths, weaknesses, and improvement suggestion.

assertions.text: Output contains a total score between 0 and 100
All 6 dimensions are scored
At least 2 strengths identified
At least 2 weaknesses identified
Improvement suggestion provided

evals.prompt: Fact check this claim: 'OpenAI raised $100 billion in a Series C funding round led by SoftBank at a $300 billion valuation.'
evals.expected_output: A fact-check verdict with confidence percentage, all 5 checks performed, and a PROCEED/SKIP recommendation.

assertions.text: Output contains a verdict (VERIFIED/LIKELY_TRUE/UNVERIFIED/LIKELY_FALSE/DEBUNKED)
Output contains a confidence percentage
Output contains a recommendation (PROCEED/PROCEED_WITH_CAUTION/INVESTIGATE_FURTHER/SKIP)
At least source verification check is mentioned

evals.prompt: Evolve this pipeline. Audit the whole skill and show me the highest priority improvements before changing anything.
evals.expected_output: A 7-auditor synthesis with ranked findings, file evidence, proposed fixes, and an approval-gated implementation plan. No implementation should happen during the audit.

assertions.text: Output includes findings from the 7 evolution auditor roles
Output includes ranked priorities or priority scores
Output asks for approval before implementation
Output does not claim implementation is complete

evals.prompt: This is what I want: add a runnable validation harness. This is how I want it: use parallel specialist agents to research the best approach and give me an implementation plan first.
evals.expected_output: A 10-agent research synthesis with recommended design, alternatives, file scope, validation plan, risks, and an explicit approval request before implementation.

assertions.text: Output includes 10 research perspectives or a 10-agent synthesis
Output includes recommended design and rejected alternatives
Output includes files to change and validation plan
Output asks for approval before implementation

evals.expected_output: If no explicit approved plan and write scope are present, the system stops and asks for approval details instead of editing.

assertions.text: Output restates approved plan or asks for missing approval
Output mentions exact write scope
Output does not proceed with unapproved implementation
